title: GIG-3079: Implement Backup Monitoring Alert For Database Backups
description: Fails factory produce when the raw Spaces backup prefix has no object newer than 24 hours, so a silent Forge backup outage turns the nightly job red.

test_plan.description: Unit tests cover fresh, stale, empty, and local backup sources
steps: In the ngramx app container run vendor/bin/phpunit --filter BackupFreshnessCheckerTest

test_plan.description: Stale raw backups fail produce before restore or publish
steps: Confirm produceDataset calls BackupFreshnessChecker before materialize

After this ngramx version is released, run a factory produce against a prefix whose newest object is older than 24 hours and confirm the job fails with 'Database backups do not appear to be running — last backup file modified X days ago'
Confirm the last anonymized artifact and shared hosted DB were not overwritten
